name: Smoke-candidate labelled set (Sentinel-2, smoke.py)
method: Prod's published smoke_plume detections were exported READ-ONLY (sqlite mode=ro over railway ssh): 460 plumes over 43 passes, 1-13 Oct 2026, almost all in the 'Possible new vehicle or tent concentration' border zones in Russia and Belarus. For each pass the same Sentinel-2 L2A bands smoke.py used (the pass and its 5 baseline passes, 20 m) were re-fetched from Copernicus and each published polygon was measured with smoke_classify.features (spectral ratios against a ring around it, SCL classes, persistence on earlier clear passes, shape, ESA WorldCover, smoke.py's SWIR hot pixels, FIRMS VIIRS points within 1 km). The Copernicus processing-unit quota ran out after 13 of the 43 passes, so 106 of the 460 were measured; all 106 are here. Two more come from a scene run on a known event (Khurais oil facility, 5 Oct 2026, FIRMS 83.5 MW) because prod's sample held almost no real smoke. LABELS were decided by eye on before (clear-pixel median of the baseline) / after true-colour crops with the outline drawn, together with the numbers: cloud = white cumulus on the outline (often not flagged by SCL); cloud_shadow = dark patches offset from cumulus, or SCL shadow; field_change = straight parcel edges, ploughing/harvest stripes, autumn vegetation, no plume and no FIRMS; smoke_plume = a semi-transparent streak from a point source that is absent before, with SWIR hot pixels or FIRMS at the source; other = water surfaces, urban blocks, rivers, or the baseline holding smoke that has since cleared; unsure = cannot be decided at 20 m (left out of every metric). No imagery is kept. Caveats: 4 positives only (2 from prod, 2 from one Khurais pass); no runway, port or tank case was measured (CDG, Sevastopol and Berdyansk passes were among those the quota stopped); labels are one person's reading and some feature signals (persistence, SCL, hot pixels) are shared between the evidence and the classifier.
